#!/bin/sh
umask 077
printf '%s\n' "$$" > /var/lib/inventory/worker.pid

    date -u '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ' > /var/lib/inventory/last-heartbeat
    sleep 30 &
    wait $!
done

Description=Confined inventory background worker

User=inventorysvc
Group=inventorysvc
RootDirectory=/srv/inventory-chroot

ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/inventory-worker
Restart=always
RestartSec=5s
UMask=0077
ReadOnlyDirectories=/
ReadWriteDirectories=/var/lib/inventory
